root_cause: The portal Start epoch can have a different UTC date from the official calendar date; it previously took priority over explicit date fields.
behavior: Prefer consistent strictly parsed MeetingDate/DateMedium/DateShort fields. Supplied malformed or conflicting dates are skipped; legacy epoch fallback remains when display dates are absent.
test_audit_review: Behavior tested through discover_meetings and its existing fetch boundary; expected dates are independent literals. No production seam or tests of private predicate structure.
